help.terms.IRPF: IRPF is personal income tax. Asset acquisition and depreciation are treated separately.
help.terms.IVA: IVA is VAT. A proposed amount does not mean that a deduction has been claimed.
help.terms.ROI: ROI is the intra-community operators register. Unverified does not mean unregistered.
help.terms.base: The depreciable base is the amount used for the schedule. Pending VAT treatment can make it provisional.
help.terms.cost: Full purchase cost; it may differ from the invoice balance after advance settlement.
help.terms.forecast: A schedule or forecast does not establish expense recognition or filing.
help.terms.paymentDeadline: Deadline to choose tax payment by direct debit. It can precede the filing deadline.
help.terms.posting: Posting records a transaction in the ledger. It does not submit a return to AEAT.
help.terms.rate: Annual depreciation rate. It is not the quarterly deduction amount.
help.terms.use: Confirmed business-use share. It is not inferred from the device type.
